detail: funnel: wall-capture — nothing fastens it; The brim bears on the inset 6 mm seat, the collar runs in `enclosure._funnel_cut_plan`, and the elbow's own collet grips the stub the spout carries — so the funnel is held down by the joint it releases from. It is a dishwasher part and comes out by hand.

funnel-drain-clamp: tube-clamp — nothing fastens it; A worm clamp closes on itself — the band draws through its own housing and the housing rides the band. What it lands on is silicone, and it goes to the dishwasher with it.

funnel-drain-stub: tube-clamp — nothing fastens it; The worm clamp closes the funnel's silicone spout onto it over the whole of the spout's land, and the pair is made up at the factory. Nothing printed is in the path: the stub leaves the machine with the funnel every time it is washed.

funnel-drain-union: tube-hung — nothing fastens it; Both its collets land on held bodies — the +Z leg takes the stub the funnel carries, the other leg hands `fluid-4` forward to turn west and return to V-B's cap cradle — so the elbow hangs between two seats with nothing printed closing on it. It is the joint the customer opens, and a thumb on that collet is the whole of the motion.

fuse-clamp: gap-press — nothing fastens it; Both faces of the slot the clamp presses into are the compressor's own — the air its power box hangs over its mounting plate — so the clamp rides the can. The plate's four holes carry the floor's posts and the grommets, and every printed feature in reach of the clamp stands on the cabinet side of them.

tee-y-a: pack — nothing fastens it; Its collets make up onto V-C's, face to face on one stub with no tube between them, and that valve stands in four printed sockets — so what holds this tee is the seat under the valve it butts.

tee-y-b: pack — nothing fastens it; Its collets make up onto V-D's, face to face on one stub with no tube between them, and that valve stands in four printed sockets — so what holds this tee is the seat under the valve it butts.
